actions.caption: Begin with the only allowed coordinates: the 5OVE/AXE hit
Enter Design to make the first prospective design decision
Prepare the hit complex locally with OpenFF Sage
Strip away visual noise so the hit and its binding pocket are easy to read
Center the hit and the local pocket where every design decision will be made
Freeze the hit pose and its receptor contacts as the starting reference
Rewrite the hit scaffold to make compound 17
Mark the transition from experimental hit to prospective prediction
See exactly where the ligand graph changed
Search 64 restrained poses for the rewritten scaffold
Apply the highest-ranked compound 17 pose
Keep the same view: the predicted pyrazole packs between Phe890 and Lys898; no direct H-bond is detected
Parameterize compound 17 without moving the prediction
Relax compound 17 and its pocket together
Compare the relaxed ligand–pocket geometry in the same fixed view
Return to Design with the compound 17 prediction
Freeze compound 17 as the reference for the next design
Merge the second fragment idea to make compound 18
See exactly where the ligand graph changed
Search 64 restrained poses for the merged ligand
Apply the highest-ranked compound 18 pose
Compare the selected ligand pose without moving the camera
Parameterize compound 18 without moving the prediction
Relax compound 18 and its pocket together
Compare the relaxed ligand–pocket geometry in the same fixed view
Return to Design with the compound 18 prediction
Freeze compound 18 as the reference for ligand growth
Grow compound 21—and create a clash with Phe890-in
Show the severe ligand–protein contacts created by compound 21 growth
See exactly where the ligand graph changed
Enumerate discrete Phe890 side-chain alternatives
Choose the predicted Phe890-out branch
The selected Phe890-out branch clears the severe contacts
See Phe890 move out of the ligand growth path
Make the selected receptor branch the new pose reference
Test compound 21 in the opened Phe890 pocket
Apply the best compound 21 pose from that branch
Compare the selected ligand pose without moving the camera
Parameterize the coupled ligand–receptor prediction
Relax compound 21 and the opened pocket together
Compare the relaxed ligand–pocket geometry in the same fixed view
Return to Design with the predicted open pocket
Freeze the predicted open pocket before the final design
Construct the final BAY-293 graph from compound 21
See exactly where the ligand graph changed
Predict BAY-293 from the frozen compound 21 state
Apply the highest-ranked BAY-293 pose
Compare the selected ligand pose without moving the camera
Parameterize BAY-293 without moving the prediction
Relax the final predicted BAY-293 complex
Compare the relaxed ligand–pocket geometry in the same fixed view

sourceScript.transformation: Capture each public mutation result; focus once on the starting ligand and retain that pocket camera for all later highlights. Phe890 stays labeled with its flanking peptide context; severe clashes are shown only from compound-21 growth until the Phe890-out branch is selected. Relaxation markers are cleared because before/after geometry is compared in place. No scientific action request removed or altered.
